title: Volleyball: NU overwhelms Letran for back-to-back wins in Unity Cup

blocks.text: Defending champion National University shook off a slow start to overcome Colegio de San Juan de Letran, 25-21, 25-14, 25-19, for back-to-back wins in the Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup on Friday at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
